|Once this wishwall is up, bugs'll be able to seek help from any able shell around. You could even try granting a couple of wishes yourself, missy!
|[[Flick the Fixer]]

[[File:Wishwall Bone Bottom.png|right|200x200px]]
<b>Wishwalls</b> are quest boards in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> where [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can accept [[Wishes]] posted on them by various [[NPCs (Silksong)|characters]].

== Function ==
Wishwalls display large coloured badges attached to the board anytime there are Wishes available.

While some Wishes are active, such as [[Wishes#Gather Wishes|{{WishType|Gather}}]] or [[Wishes#Hunt Wishes|{{WishType|Hunt}}]], wishwalls will have a small recipient where Hornet can deliver the requested items. In order to complete [[Wishes#Donate Wishes|{{WishType|Donate}}]] Wishes, Hornet must go up to a wishwall and deposit the {{S|[[Shell Shards]]}} and {{R|[[Rosaries]]}} required.

As Hornet keeps progressing with the story and meets certain conditions, new Wishes will be added to the wishwalls.

== Location ==
There are a total of three wishwalls in [[Pharloom]], one in each of the main settlements.
